_comment: I5 docs-conformance exceptions baseline (Invariant I5). Each entry is a backticked span (from an architecture doc) that datrix/scripts/gates/repo-hygiene/lib/check_docs_conformance.py cannot resolve to a real file/directory/module (or a Class.member claim naming a member the class does not have), verified to be legitimately non-existent (a migration-history 'what was removed' claim, a negative/prohibition claim, or another confirmed-intentional non-existence) rather than a genuine drift defect. A NEW entry here is a deliberate, reviewed exception -- never a way to silence a script complaint without reading why it fired.
